title: Bank Of Montreal (TSX:BMO) Drops Trading Fees For Self Directed Investors
summary: Bank of Montreal (TSX:BMO) said BMO InvestorLine will move to $0 commissions on all stocks and ETFs for self-directed clients. The bank stated it is the first major Canadian institution to offer zero-commission trading across its digital brokerage platform. BMO confirmed that administrative fees tied to self-directed InvestorLine accounts will also be removed as part of the change.
